what: A small dot always follows the cursor .4s late (power3). When it is over a photo or card with a label, it bounces .85→1 (.7s back.out(2)) and expands into a round pill holding that text (clip-path .4s cubic-bezier(.75,0,.25,1), the text appears immediately on entering, and on leaving it stays .25s then goes off over .15s). The pill blends with difference, so it becomes a different color over each photo color beneath. It re-detects what is under the cursor even when that changes by scrolling

options.text: Text for an empty label, default ‹View›
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Child that the pill expands into — its text is the data-label
options.look: plain mode: no dot, no difference blending, no bounce, only over a label, a faint pill (surface 60% + blur 40px) shifts to 10% left of and 33% above the cursor and turns on in .2s — the cursor stays visible
options.ease: Follow curve, default power3 — brand power2.out(follow .2)

note: Because of difference blending, the pill color shows the text color (--kf-ink) inverted — dark over bright photos, light over dark backgrounds. Not attached on touch devices

from.where: shared.js .mn-cursor (pill in the Showreel and Work cells, ”View all showreels” and ”View work”)
shared.js ”Read the article” pill on case · news cards (original card-hover — quickTo x·y .2s power2.out, opacity .2s)
